surface_mechanism_description: The surface mechanism involves the alternate evaporation of monolayers of zinc and tellurium, with the growth occurring through stepwise deposition. Excess incident atoms re-evaporate due to their higher vapor pressures compared to the compound, allowing for self-stabilization of the surface and precise control of film thickness.
